headline: OpenAI's Luna hits 11.2% — day 2 at the top
summary: OpenAI/gpt-5.6-luna-20260709 claimed the #1 spot yesterday and is holding it today at 11.2% token share, marking its first time at rank 1. Zhipu AI's glm-5.3-flash is on day 2 of an all-time high at 10.3%, while MiniMax's free tier model is on day 3 of record territory. DeepSeek slipped 2.2 points overnight but still commands 18.5% across its fleet. Four new models entered the rankings, including Tencent's hy4-preview at rank 10.
